about: A day given notes (its row made then, with the series' tags and people copied onto it), then a place, then a title for all events with another day renamed at Google during it; the notes undone keep the row for its place, and the row still shows the series' tags and people, which it never owned; a redo and a redo of that redo leave them so: a day's tags and people are its own only when its own list says so, otherwise the series' copy, which an undo never takes away (series-model.md, Own Fields; decisions.md, "A day kept by an undo shows the series' tags and people it does not own"; seed 307 case 183; review of 94693e30 to cb2c6082, R3; x-undo-fields)
